# Audit: Nincada with Random(4) = 0 (seed 1), a No then a Yes to the plain question,
# two Noes, and a Shedinja (seed 16).
party 290 20
party 290 20
party 290 25
party 290 30
> start
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to evolve it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Evolution Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> answer yes
> seed 1
> choose 1
dialog information "# 290 Nincada, L.20, XP:8000, XP to next level:1261" -> OK
dialog confirmation "Your Nincada can evolve into Ninjask. Do you want to evolve it? NOTE: Nincada will evolve into Ninjask AND Shedinja every 3 of 4 times." -> Yes
dialog information "Nincada evolved into Ninjask!" -> OK
rand 4 = 0
dialog information "Shedinja didn't appear." -> OK
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to evolve it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Evolution Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> answer no yes
> choose 2
dialog information "# 290 Nincada, L.20, XP:8000, XP to next level:1261" -> OK
dialog confirmation "Your Nincada can evolve into Ninjask. Do you want to evolve it? NOTE: Nincada will evolve into Ninjask AND Shedinja every 3 of 4 times." -> No
dialog confirmation "Your Nincada can evolve into Ninjask. Do you want to evolve it?" -> Yes
dialog information "Nincada evolved into Ninjask!" -> OK
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to evolve it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Evolution Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> answer no no
> choose 3
dialog information "# 290 Nincada, L.25, XP:15625, XP to next level:1951" -> OK
dialog confirmation "Your Nincada can evolve into Ninjask. Do you want to evolve it? NOTE: Nincada will evolve into Ninjask AND Shedinja every 3 of 4 times." -> No
dialog confirmation "Your Nincada can evolve into Ninjask. Do you want to evolve it?" -> No
> menu Actions > Evolve a POKéMON
dialog information "Doubleclick a POKéMON in the Statistics window to evolve it. Once you have doubleclicked on a POKéMON, Evolution Mode will be disabled." -> OK
> answer yes
> seed 16
> choose 4
dialog information "# 290 Nincada, L.30, XP:27000, XP to next level:2791" -> OK
dialog confirmation "Your Nincada can evolve into Ninjask. Do you want to evolve it? NOTE: Nincada will evolve into Ninjask AND Shedinja every 3 of 4 times." -> Yes
dialog information "Nincada evolved into Ninjask!" -> OK
rand 4 = 2
dialog information "Nincada also evolved into Shedinja!" -> OK
